// CASE js_object_two_awaits expect=fire
export async function loadProfiles(ids, width) {
	const results = new Array(ids.length);
	let next = 0;
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < ids.length) {
				const index = next++;
				results[index] = {
					user: await loadUser(ids[index]),
					orders: await loadOrders(ids[index]),
				};
			}
		}),
	);
	return results;
}

// CASE js_call_wrapping_two_awaits expect=fire
export async function syncAll(ids, width) {
	let next = 0;
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < ids.length) {
				const index = next++;
				report(await push(ids[index]), await verify(ids[index]));
			}
		}),
	);
}

// CASE js_awaited_receiver expect=fire
export async function sendAll(ids, width, pool) {
	let next = 0;
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < ids.length) {
				const index = next++;
				await (await pool()).send(ids[index]);
			}
		}),
	);
}

// CASE js_canonical_control expect=pass
export async function mapLimit(items, width, operation) {
	let next = 0;
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < items.length) {
				const index = next++;
				await operation(items[index]);
			}
		}),
	);
}
